steps.instruction:
thread_links.csv、方向別成功率、路徑ETX表；全部數字、預算與門檻均為教育用假設，非引用系統的實際規格或服務承諾。只用離線計算或模擬，不操作發射器。
在交接件中加入「一、建立系統邊界與輸入帳」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：輸入表應能唯一重建式 1/0.9+1/0.9 與 1/0.99+1/0.7，兩情境的改變量可追溯；不能把本題門檻標成 Silicon Labs 的規格。

steps.instructionEn:
thread_links.csv, directional success rates and route ETX table. All numbers, budgets and thresholds are synthetic educational assumptions, not system specifications or service guarantees. Use offline calculation or simulation without operating a transmitter.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for 1. Define the system boundary and input ledger: The ledger must uniquely reconstruct 1/0.9+1/0.9 and 1/0.99+1/0.7 and trace each changed quantity; do not attribute the exercise threshold to Silicon Labs.

Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.

stages.title: 一、建立系統邊界與輸入帳
stages.titleEn: 1. Define the system boundary and input ledger
stages.description: 閱讀來源 Thread mesh networking，找出本課機制與適用範圍。以自己的圖解標示：簡化獨立成功率p鏈路需平均1/p次嘗試，多跳路徑ETX相加；未納入競爭、確認損失或非對稱。 將輸入逐項抄入有單位的表：路徑A兩跳成功率0.9/0.9；路徑B兩跳0.99/0.7；皆傳同一個資料單位。 對每個量註明固定、改變、推導或未建模；將引用內容與教學假設分欄。
stages.descriptionEn: Read Thread mesh networking to locate the mechanism and its scope. Draw your own model boundary: A link with independent success probabilityp needs1/p mean attempts; path ETX sums links, excluding contention, ACK loss and asymmetry. Transcribe the inputs into a unit-bearing ledger: PathA has two links with success0.9/0.9; pathB has0.99/0.7; both carry the same data unit. Label each quantity fixed, changed, derived or unmodelled, separating sourced concepts from teaching assumptions.
